newsitem.title: UK: CSFB takes financing team from Nomura.
newsitem.headline: CSFB takes financing team from Nomura.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston, the investment banking arm of Credit Suisse, said it has employed a five-person team from Japanese bank Nomura to form a Principal Transactions Group Europe reporting to Andy Stone.
Stone is managing director and global head of the Principal Transactions Group, Credit Suisse said in a statement.
The group will act as principal in structured debt and equity transactions involving real estate assets, consumer loans, business receivables and other financial assets.
The team consists of Garry Lawrence; Kim Duncan; Jeff Nash; Chris Patrick; and Lorna Shearin.
The bank said it expects to add around 10 staff to the core team during 1997.
